name: Alpha Futures
legal_entity_and_hq: Alpha Futures Limited (company no. 15655643, England and Wales), 1 Allied Business Centre, Coldharbour Lane, Harpenden, England, AL5 4UT, UK
instruments: CME Group futures (CME, CBOT, NYMEX, COMEX), incl. Micro Bitcoin (MBT) and Micro Ether (MET), which count as full mini contracts

programs.name: Standard
programs.drawdown_type: EOD trailing (from highest end-of-day balance), stops trailing at starting balance
programs.max_contracts_50k: 5 minis / 50 micros (scaling plan applies in Qualified)
programs.payout_frequency: up to 4 requests per month, each after 5 winning days of $200+
programs.payout_rules_note: Min $500, max $3,000 per request (50K); up to 50% of account profit per request; MLL does not reset to $0 after payout. Terms say payments typically processed within 3 business days (up to 14 with extra verification).
programs.notes: Qualified 50K has a $1,000 Daily Loss Guard (soft lock until next session). Evaluation rebills monthly until passed or cancelled. Alpha also sells a no-evaluation 'Direct' account (50K: $519 one-time, $2,000 MLL, $1,000 daily loss guard, 20% consistency, withdrawal targets $3,000 then $2,000, max $2,000 per withdrawal, 90% split).

programs.name: Zero
programs.drawdown_type: EOD trailing, stops at starting balance
programs.consistency_rule: none in evaluation; 40% in Qualified account
programs.payout_frequency: up to 4 requests per month, each after 5 winning days of $200+
programs.payout_rules_note: Min $200, max $1,500 per request (50K); up to 50% of profit per request.
programs.notes: Daily Loss Guard is 2% of starting balance and is a soft breach: positions flattened and account locked until next trading day 6PM ET, not closed. Sizes 25K/50K/100K.

programs.name: Advanced
programs.drawdown_type: EOD trailing, stops at starting balance
programs.consistency_rule: 40% in evaluation; none in Qualified account
programs.payout_frequency: up to 4 requests per month, each after 5 winning days of $200+
programs.payout_rules_note: Min $1,000, max $15,000 per request (all sizes); up to 50% of profit per request.
programs.notes: A $149 activation fee per Advanced Qualified account applied before 2026-07-08; accounts bought after that date have no activation fee. No news restrictions on Advanced Qualified. Sizes 50K/100K/150K.

news_trading: Restricted: no restrictions in evaluations or Advanced Qualified; on Standard, Zero and Direct Qualified no orders may be executed from 2 minutes before to 2 minutes after high-impact (ForexFactory red folder) news; 4-minute window for high-impact speeches. Violations void profits; first violation is a warning, later ones breach the account.
ea_bots_allowed: Not allowed: AI, bots and full automation prohibited on all account types; semi-automated tools (signal indicators) allowed if the trader places and manages trades manually; 100+ trades per day strategies not accepted
copy_trading: Allowed only when a single person trades their own Alpha Futures accounts; group, reverse (hedging across accounts) and automated copy trading prohibited
overnight_weekend_holding: Not allowed: all trades must be closed by 4:20 PM ET every day (Alpha closes positions if the trader does not).
restricted_countries_note: 61 restricted countries incl. Serbia, Croatia, Bosnia, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Albania, Kosovo, Slovenia, Romania, Bulgaria, Russia, Ukraine, Belarus, Turkey, China, Vietnam, Philippines, Malaysia, Pakistan, Nigeria. Trading also not permitted while travelling in a listed country. US is not on the list. https://help.alpha-futures.com/en/articles/9523389-countries-with-limitations
path_to_live: Risk/Alpha Prime teams may call a trader to live after e.g. 5 performance fees on one Qualified account or significant lifetime payouts. Live 50K: $0 start, $2,000 EOD drawdown, daily payouts, no consistency or news limits. Two options: Alpha Futures Live (80% split, daily uncapped withdrawals) or Alpha Prime (60% split plus a 12-month salary funded by 50% of Qualified sim profit, capped at $75,000). All Qualified accounts close when called to live.

current_public_promo.applies_to: Standard, Advanced and Direct (MYALPHA40 gives 40% off Zero); valid October 19 to 31, 2026

affiliate_program.commission: 15% recurring on subscriptions from referred new customers while active, plus 15% on their resets; no cap
affiliate_program.notes: Link created in the dashboard 'Affiliate' section. Running ads with the affiliate link ends affiliate status. Referred customers get 10% off by default unless a promo is active. Affiliate payouts processed within 48 hours, one request per day.

Payout frequency changed to up to 4 times per month; Zero daily loss limit replaced by a 2% soft Daily Loss Guard; 90% flat split (reported by a third-party tracker)
Path to Live structure updated (Alpha Prime 60% + salary vs Live 80%)
